description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy' that serves as a base for command strategy classes related to policy querying within a persistence actor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends another abstract class, implements method overriding, and is part of a package concerning policy command strategies.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for policy query command strategies, parameterized with command type C, extending AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Class object to match command types.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Overrides method to return the next entity tag based on the command and policy, can return an empty Optional.
